status: Procedural metadata received before raw candidate sources or evidence; no grading outcome

reportedUniformLimits.appleRequestedAccessibilityActivate: Routes to actual XCUI tap; no AX performAction proof.
reportedUniformLimits.androidActivation: Native semantic OnClick; no OS physical touch.
reportedUniformLimits.blocked_disabled: Observer declines dispatch; not a performed physical tap.

independentAssessmentPolicy.callbacks: Assess actual captured count/payload facts independently of requested activation-method proof.
independentAssessmentPolicy.requestedTap: Requires actual physical touch/tap execution proof. Native semantic OnClick does not establish it.
independentAssessmentPolicy.requestedAccessibilityActivate: Requires actual accessible/native semantic action proof. iOS XCUI tap alone does not establish AX activation. Android actual current-node native semantic OnClick can establish native semantic activation if executed and bound to that node.
independentAssessmentPolicy.blockedBeforeDispatch: No delivered native activation is established. Record method coverage as UNASSESSED; zero actual callbacks can still be observed.
independentAssessmentPolicy.physicalHitBounds: UIKit AX frames establish AX geometry, not physical hit bounds.
independentAssessmentPolicy.typography: Source fonts do not establish resolved runtime font family, size or scaling.
